objective: 2026-08-03 A1-base rebind and manager precision correction of the C14-LIVE-A2/B3 Plan/FREEZE packet: the frozen D1-D9 design, T01-T15 matrix, hazards, ten-path write set and non-goals are bound to accepted-A1 manager adjudication P1 1e8dd545f27bd1f22879b067ad0e1b3f4e2ecbc4. After manager integration and an accepted fresh independent correction preflight, repair only CFR-168 C14-LIVE-A2/B3 on the accepted Python HTTP Upload mutation-response path: freeze the conservative EFFECT_MAY_HAVE_STARTED boundary, transfer the selected prepared owner to the mutation slot before fallible rejected cleanup, keep wire publication as a borrow, separate pre-effect abort from post-effect finish, retry cleanup exactly once on the same non-consuming owner, preserve one response attempt, and report ADR-020-compatible decision-work and separate wire state. All T01-T15 baselines and A1 exception behavior must be recomputed on L from current source.

risk.rationale: The repair crosses durable-effect, response ownership, request-loop accounting, socket framing, error-origin, and canonical-contract boundaries. Historical GET and MR-write sources gave conflicting post-effect cleanup rules, and a later manager adjudication corrects the terminal interpretation, so exact phase assignment and an independent Ultra review are mandatory. The 2026-08-03 A1-base rebind adds a second conflicting-source axis: the accepted A1 package rewrote pre-effect cleanup/exception-chain behavior in four callees reachable from handle_http_upload, so the pre-M oracles must be re-established on live source before implementation.
